name: @discere-os/vorbis.wasm
description: WebAssembly port of libvorbis - Ogg Vorbis audio encoding and decoding library with SIMD optimization

imports.module: data:application/javascript,export const createRequire = () => (id) => { if (id === 'path') return { dirname: () => '', join: (...args) => args.join('/') }; if (id === 'url') return { fileURLToPath: (url) => url.replace('file://', '') }; if (id === 'fs') return { readFileSync: () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); } }; throw new Error(`Module ${id} not found`); }; export default { createRequire };
imports.path: data:application/javascript,export const dirname = () => ''; export const join = (...args) => args.join('/'); export default { dirname, join };
imports.url: data:application/javascript,export const fileURLToPath = (url) => url.replace('file://', ''); export default { fileURLToPath };
imports.fs: data:application/javascript,export const readFileSync = () => { throw new Error('fs not supported'); }; export default { readFileSync };

tasks.build:main:meson: meson setup build-main --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross -Dmain_module=true -Dside_module=false -Dsimd=true --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-main vorbis-main && meson install -C build-main
tasks.build:side:meson: meson setup build-side --cross-file=scripts/emscripten.cross -Dmain_module=false -Dside_module=true -Dsimd=true --prefix=$PWD/install -Dlibdir=wasm -Dbindir=wasm && meson compile -C build-side vorbis-side && meson install -C build-side && python3 scripts/postinstall.py $PWD/install
tasks.build:wasm:meson: deno task build:main:meson && deno task build:side:meson
tasks.build:all: deno task build:wasm && deno task build:npm
tasks.publish:npm: deno task build:all && cd npm && npm publish
tasks.publish:dry: deno task build:all && cd npm && npm publish --dry-run
tasks.check:all: deno check src/lib/index.ts && deno check demo-deno.ts && deno check tests/deno/*.ts
tasks.fmt: deno fmt src/ tests/ demo-deno.ts bench/
tasks.lint: deno lint src/ tests/ demo-deno.ts bench/
